Kilmar Ábrego García, the man at the centre of Trump's deportation battle, leaves the US for Spain of his own accord. An Iowa town shelters in place as the army prepares to detonate the US stockpile of lead azide, and Trump calls a pardon for Nvidia boss Huang 'always an option'.
